template.name: VmMatrix Double Zero
template.entry_long: crossabove(close, open) and sma(close,{p0}) > sma(close,{p1}) and volume_ratio(volume,{p2}) > {p0}
template.notes: The double-zero level is the previous close, which equals the current open, so the trigger is a close crossing back above the prior close, with the matrix bias read as a 10/50 SMA stack and the optional volume check as volume_ratio(volume,20) > 1; all lengths are fallbacks. The terminal-time window, ATR acceleration gate, daily CCI, adaptive take-profit and pip stops are not expressible.
